status: proposal; no implementation or published qualification
numberingGate: Recheck authoritative parent main after worksheet 27 lands; do not allocate a tracked artifact kit before that check.

scopes.server: Actual production artifact conversion/store/read/release boundary with controlled invocation and authenticated host lanes separate.
scopes.client: Actual production transfer client consuming independently constructed raw wire replies.
scopes.runtime: Actual Rust producer, authenticated host, production TypeScript transport, saved browser and packaged Proton bytes.
scopes.checker: Existing parent shared Rust runner and saved-report checker, no second compatibility runner.

cases.requirement: An empty artifact is a complete file with the SHA-256 of zero bytes.
cases.expected: Manifest length zero, no required read, independent empty digest, one verified empty file, release exact generation.

cases.requirement: Preserve byte lengths immediately below, at and above a full chunk and across three chunks.
cases.expected: Every returned offset, count, next offset and decoded digest equals literal recipe windows; assembled digest equals independent whole-file digest.

cases.requirement: Transfer a file larger than the 1 MiB request bound without a whole-file inline response.
cases.expected: 17 bounded reads, exact 1048833-byte saved file and literal independent digest; no regeneration during reads/release. Indexed chunks differ so a correct-offset but wrong-content reply cannot pass.

cases.requirement: Binary content covers all 256 values, NUL and invalid UTF-8.
cases.expected: Exact binary digest preserved; preview failure cannot replace original bytes or authorize lossy re-encoding.

cases.requirement: BOM, CRLF, Unicode and final CRLF survive original download and ZIP entries.
cases.expected: Strict preview is separate; saved file and ZIP entry length/digest match literal bytes.

cases.requirement: Accept exactly 16 MiB per file.
cases.expected: 256 reads at most 65536 bytes; verified length 16777216 and literal digest.

cases.requirement: Refuse a 16 MiB plus one file before retained publication.
cases.expected: No ready manifest or partial inventory; retained/reserved bytes return to prior counts.

cases.requirement: Accept exactly 64 MiB over four individually valid files.
cases.expected: Four independent verified digests, 67108864 decoded bytes; exact reservation then zero after release.

cases.requirement: Refuse aggregate 64 MiB plus one while every file is individually valid.
cases.expected: No partial inventory or retained allocation; rollback preserves other connections.

cases.requirement: Accept 256 safe empty files; refuse 257 independently of byte limits.
cases.expected: File count and no partial inventory observed, zero decoded bytes does not waive descriptor limits.

cases.requirement: Check complete encoded JSON-RPC manifest reply at 131072/131073 UTF-8 bytes independently of decoded bytes.
cases.expected: 256 empty safe artifacts, literal envelope recipes, exact byte counts; one-over fails before Ready and rolls back reservation.

cases.requirement: Bound diagnostics separately, and include ready diagnostics in the manifest budget.
cases.expected: Independent failed diagnostic envelope 131072/131073 bytes; bounded fixed fallback on overflow, no oversized echo.

cases.requirement: Decode documented SDK binary content only as canonical padded standard base64.
cases.expected: Only AA== decodes to one zero byte; noncanonical spelling rejects entire set and publishes no partial inventory.

cases.requirement: A malformed or failed backend result never exposes a partial transfer set.
cases.expected: Valid artifact followed by invalid binary/path, bounded diagnostics, invocation count one, no Ready, zero retained reservation.

cases.requirement: Reads are pure immutable slices rather than advancing an implicit server cursor.
cases.expected: Two identical reads and an out-of-order valid window return identical literal bytes/digests; SDK invocation count remains one.

cases.requirement: Validate EOF, beyond EOF, zero and oversized counts, integer mathematics.
cases.expected: EOF can return empty; beyond EOF/0/65537 counts reject; exact integral spellings 1.0 and 1e0 accepted; non-integral/underflow/unsafe counts reject without changing store.

cases.requirement: Select only offered exact canonical profile/version and available provider.
cases.expected: Missing/unavailable/wrong version/build suffix/wrong provider refuses before producer invocation, retained bytes zero.

cases.requirement: Preserve old-client/new-host and new-client/legacy-host behavior.
cases.expected: Frozen v1 shape unchanged, new capability ignored by old clients, undeclared binary refusal retained, selected-profile failure never retries through v1.

cases.requirement: Validate literal raw JSON before lossy object parsing.
cases.expected: Duplicate and escaped-equivalent members at outer/nested depths, malformed strings, trailing JSON and non-text frames reject before authority changes.

cases.requirement: Independently bound raw generation 1 MiB and read/release 16 KiB request frames.
cases.expected: Exact/one-over original UTF-8 byte boundaries including whitespace/escapes; normalization cannot hide overflow.

cases.requirement: Wrong cookie, Origin, Host, session and uninitialized connection cannot invoke transfer methods.
cases.expected: Actual authenticated host rejects each; producer invocations and retained reservations unchanged.

cases.requirement: Same cookie on a different connection does not transfer generation/artifact authority.
cases.expected: Stolen handle read/release rejects, original owner can still read expected bytes and release normally.

cases.requirement: Bind generation/artifact IDs and profile/provider/session/target/IR context.
cases.expected: Wrong IDs/context reject, no fabricated byte set, original retained generation unchanged.

cases.requirement: A second generation cannot silently replace current Generating or Ready state.
cases.expected: Refusal preserves original generation/reservation and does not cause a second backend invocation.

cases.requirement: Retain only the bounded last-release identity for idempotence.
cases.expected: Exact release empties store, same release returns empty success, read afterward fails; older release cannot clear newer generation.

cases.requirement: Connection/session/host closure releases owned bytes and reservations.
cases.expected: Measured retained/reserved delta goes to zero and stale handles fail; unrelated connection state remains.

cases.requirement: 64 MiB host-wide reservation is shared across connections and rolled back.
cases.expected: Existing 64 MiB retained generation blocks another positive-byte reservation while generation slots remain available; release permits later valid acceptance; failure cannot leak reservation. Empty bytes alone do not exhaust byte quota; independent slot/descriptor bounds still apply.

cases.requirement: At most 64 Generating plus Ready generations reserve host-wide slots, including zero-byte sets.
cases.expected: 64 empty generations occupy 64 slots and zero decoded bytes; the 65th refuses before producer invocation. Release/close/failure frees exactly its slot; later acceptance succeeds without affecting other owners.

cases.requirement: Reserve a generation slot before invocation and bytes before conversion.
cases.expected: Mixed held Generating and Ready states sum to 64; another invocation is blocked. Backend failure and connection closure release their reservations when bounded invocation ends; no double-free or leaked slot.

cases.requirement: At most one active producer invocation/response credit is held before backend invocation, separate from generation slots and decoded bytes.
cases.expected: One held invocation prevents a second invocation with capacity refusal and no automatic retry/replacement; completion/failure frees its invocation credit while a Ready generation retains its independent slot/byte reservation. Concrete large process-response policy remains proposed and unqualified.

cases.requirement: Unknown acceptance never causes automatic regeneration.
cases.expected: One producer invocation, no client verified set; owning socket closes and actual reservation clears after bounded invocation ends.

cases.requirement: Stopping a synchronous generation wait does not claim remote cancellation.
cases.expected: Client abandons waiting with honest status; late manifest disposed/released or socket closed; no fabricated generator termination evidence.

cases.requirement: Use bounded portable relative components and paths.
cases.expected: Traversal/absolute/drive/UNC/control/forbidden characters, trailing dot/space, device names including superscript COM/LPT, component255 and whole-path4096UTF8/1024UTF16 exact/one-over cases.

cases.requirement: Freeze NFKC Unicode17 then full default casefold Unicode9 then NFC Unicode17 collision policy.
cases.expected: Duplicate, full-casefold, normalization, compatibility and prefix collisions reject complete set. Table provenance and common cases are checked, not runtime toLowerCase alone.

cases.requirement: Reject unsafe context/paths/IDs/lengths/digests before allocation.
cases.expected: Repeated artifact ID, wrong profile/producer, uppercase digest, invalid hex, dishonest lengths and aggregate overflow never create a verified object or download.

cases.requirement: Correlate and verify every raw chunk before assembly advances.
cases.expected: Wrong generation/artifact, skipped/overlap/offset/nextOffset, early empty, overlong decoded chunk, malformed/noncanonical base64 and digest corruption reject before Blob/ZIP and trigger exact cleanup.

cases.requirement: Capture source/request/provider/profile/target/IR input before first await.
cases.expected: Caller mutates original after start; observed request and final accepted context retain original captured values.

cases.requirement: Recheck current context after manifest, each read, hashing and release.
cases.expected: Replacement/cancel at each held boundary suppresses stale output and releases only exact old generation; never clears/releases newer generation.

cases.requirement: Unknown retention is visible and closes owning socket.
cases.expected: Release timeout/failure closes exact connection, no false Released/cleanup success; actual host drop observed separately.

cases.requirement: Real SDK fixture backend runs through registry/invoker/provider and authenticated host.
cases.expected: Resolved producer/version evidence and exactly one invocation; supported real Rust text backend workflow also required.

cases.requirement: Production transport saves real Chromium binary file, text file and project ZIP.
cases.expected: Read saved bytes and ZIP entries independently against fixed recipe length/hash, no route-intercepted artifact replies; CDP event alone insufficient.

cases.requirement: Packaged Proton completes actual save dialogs and preserves bytes.
cases.expected: Executable hash, OS/architecture, exact revisions/profile/producer and independently inspected saved binary/text/ZIP entries; click alone insufficient.

cases.requirement: One shared parent checker recomputes fixed comparisons and report verdicts.
cases.expected: Byte/digest/offset/path/context/offer/identity/release-effect mutations with retained pass claims reject; missing/reordered records and false qualified flag reject; unsupported is never qualified.
